page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9h.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by the Hygon 7447v processor, which operates at a baseline clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, resulting in a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring all storage operations to utilize external network-attached volumes. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no hardware accelerators or GPUs integrated into this instance type.

With a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the instance is structured for compute-heavy workloads that do not require massive memory footprints. This hardware profile offers qualitative cost efficiency for processing-intensive tasks by minimizing expenditures on unused memory. Typical workloads include batch processing, distributed analytics, web serving, and compute-bound application servers.
